variables.name: Servicio
variables.input:
fetch logs
|filter dt.system.bucket =="logs_integracion"
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| parse aws.log_group, "'/aws/ecs/srv/' LD:cluster 'ws-'"
| filter in("*", $Cluster) or in(concat(cluster, "ws"), $Cluster)
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD 'X-Referer=' LD:referer ','"
| fieldsAdd service = splitString(referer, "-")[3]
| filter isNotNull(service)
| summarize responses = count(), by: { service }
| fields service
| append [data record(service = "*")]
| sort service asc

0.content:
## Nexus
Cluster: uno, varios o `*` = todos. Servicio: `*` = todos (no aplica a LATENCIA ADAPTADOR, ADAPTADORES EN USO ni LATENCIA POR ADAPTADOR). Canal: `37`, varios `37,01`, `*` = todos (no aplica a ERROR LOGS ni RESUMEN ERRORES POR CANAL). Rquid para la sección 4.

2.title: Respuestas adaptador
2.query:
fetch logs
|filter dt.system.bucket =="logs_integracion"
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| parse aws.log_group, "'/aws/ecs/srv/' LD:cluster 'ws-'"
| filter in("*", $Cluster) or in(concat(cluster, "ws"), $Cluster)
| filter $Servicio == "*" or contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' SPACE? INT:code"
| fieldsAdd outcome = if(isNull(code), "unknown", else: if(code >= 200 and code < 300, "ok_2xx", else: if(code == 412, "business_412", else: "error")))
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:channel_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd channel = coalesce(channel_a, channel_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ","))
| summarize responses = count()

6.title: RESPUESTAS ADAPTADOR EN EL TIEMPO
6.description: Los errores 412 son errores de negocio
6.query:
fetch logs
|filter dt.system.bucket =="logs_integracion"
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")

8.title: RESPUESTAS ADAPTADOR POR SERVICIO
8.query:
fetch logs
|filter dt.system.bucket =="logs_integracion"
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| parse aws.log_group, "'/aws/ecs/srv/' LD:cluster 'ws-'"
| filter in("*", $Cluster) or in(concat(cluster, "ws"), $Cluster)
| filter $Servicio == "*" or contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' SPACE? INT:code"
| fieldsAdd outcome = if(isNull(code), "unknown", else: if(code >= 200 and code < 300, "ok_2xx", else: if(code == 412, "business_412", else: "error")))
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:CH_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:CH_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd CH = coalesce(CH_a, CH_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(CH, splitString($Canal, ","))
| parse content, "LD 'X-Referer=' LD:referer ','"
| fieldsAdd service = splitString(referer, "-")[3]
| summarize responses = count(),
    ok_2xx = countIf(outcome == "ok_2xx"),
    business_412 = countIf(outcome == "business_412"),
    error = countIf(outcome == "error"),
    error_4xx = countIf(outcome == "error" and code >= 400 and code < 500),
    error_5xx = countIf(outcome == "error" and code >= 500 and code < 600),
    unknown = countIf(outcome == "unknown"),
    by: { service, CH }
| fieldsAdd pct_error = round(100.0 * error / responses, decimals: 2)
| sort error desc, responses desc
| limit 200

9.title: SUMATORIA EVENTOS APIS
9.query:
fetch logs
|filter dt.system.bucket =="logs_integracion"
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| parse aws.log_group, "'/aws/ecs/srv/' LD:cluster 'ws-'"
| filter in("*", $Cluster) or in(concat(cluster, "ws"), $Cluster)
| filter $Servicio == "*" or contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' SPACE? INT:code"
| fieldsAdd outcome = if(isNull(code), "unknown", else: if(code >= 200 and code < 300, "ok_2xx", else: if(code == 412, "business_412", else: "error")))
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:channel_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd channel = coalesce(channel_a, channel_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ","))
| filter isNotNull(code) and not (code >= 200 and code < 300)
| parse content, "LD 'X-Referer=' LD:referer ','"
| fieldsAdd service = splitString(referer, "-")[3]
| parse content, "LD '\"code\":\"' LD:error_code '\"'"
| parse content, "LD '\"system\":\"' LD:error_system '\"'"
| parse content, "LD '\"message\":\"' LD:error_message '\"'"
| summarize total = count(), by: { code, error_system, error_code, error_message, service, channel }
| sort total desc
| limit 1000

10.title: ERRORES DE MAPEO (% sobre respuestas)
10.query:
fetch logs
|filter dt.system.bucket =="logs_integracion"
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| parse aws.log_group, "'/aws/ecs/srv/' LD:cluster 'ws-'"
| filter in("*", $Cluster) or in(concat(cluster, "ws"), $Cluster)
| filter $Servicio == "*" or contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::") or (contains(content, "GenericExceptionMapper") and contains(content, "HttpCode::"))
| fieldsAdd is_resp = contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD 'Exception:' SPACE? INT:mapper_code"
| parse content, "LD 'HttpCode::' SPACE? INT:http_code"
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:channel_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd channel = coalesce(channel_a, channel_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ","))
| parse content, "LD 'X-Referer=' LD:referer ','"
| fieldsAdd service = splitString(referer, "-")[3]
| summarize responses = countIf(is_resp), mapping_errors = countIf(not is_resp and http_code == 400), by: { service, channel }
| fieldsAdd pct_mapping = round(100.0 * mapping_errors / responses, decimals: 2)
| filter mapping_errors > 0
| sort mapping_errors desc
| limit 1000

| fieldsAdd is_resp = contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD 'Exception:' SPACE? INT:mapper_code"
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel_a ','"

12.title: DETALLE ERRORES DE MAPEO
12.query:
fetch logs
|filter dt.system.bucket =="logs_integracion"
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| parse aws.log_group, "'/aws/ecs/srv/' LD:cluster 'ws-'"
| filter in("*", $Cluster) or in(concat(cluster, "ws"), $Cluster)
| filter $Servicio == "*" or contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "GenericExceptionMapper") and contains(content, "HttpCode::")
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:CH_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:CH_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd CH = coalesce(CH_a, CH_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(CH, splitString($Canal, ","))
// mapping errors are HttpCode 400; the Exception code can be a backend code (e.g. 1111 = connection refused, HttpCode 503)
| parse content, "LD 'HttpCode::' SPACE? INT:http_code"
| filter http_code == 400
| parse content, "LD 'Exception:' LD '::' SPACE? LD ' .' ALPHA:direction ':' SPACE? LD:rule '. 1=' LD:params SPACE? '::HEAD::'"
| fieldsAdd args = splitString(params, ", ")
| fieldsAdd p1 = args[0],
            p2 = substring(args[1], from: 2),
            p3 = substring(args[2], from: 2)
| fieldsAdd field = if(contains(rule, "para: %3"), p3, else: p1)
// p1 can carry raw customer data (e.g. a whole product record): show only its shape, digits as 9, max 20 chars
| fieldsAdd p1_shape = substring(replacePattern(p1, "DIGIT", "9"), from: 0, to: 20)
| fieldsAdd detail = replaceString(
                       replaceString(
                         replaceString(rule, "%1", coalesce(p1_shape, "%1")),
                       "%2", coalesce(p2, "%2")),
                     "%3", coalesce(p3, "%3"))
// lines without X-Referer have no service: the adapter tells at least where it failed
| fieldsAdd adapter = replaceString(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/", "")
| parse content, "LD 'X-Referer=' LD:referer ','"
| fieldsAdd service = splitString(referer, "-")[3]
| summarize total = count(), example = takeFirst(detail),
    by: { direction, rule, field, adapter, service, CH }
| sort total desc
| limit 1000

13.title: RQUIDS CON ERROR 4XX/5XX
13.query:
fetch logs
|filter dt.system.bucket =="logs_integracion"
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| parse aws.log_group, "'/aws/ecs/srv/' LD:cluster 'ws-'"
| filter in("*", $Cluster) or in(concat(cluster, "ws"), $Cluster)
| filter $Servicio == "*" or contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' SPACE? INT:code"
| fieldsAdd outcome = if(isNull(code), "unknown", else: if(code >= 200 and code < 300, "ok_2xx", else: if(code == 412, "business_412", else: "error")))
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:CH_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:CH_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd CH = coalesce(CH_a, CH_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(CH, splitString($Canal, ","))
| filter outcome == "error"
| parse content, "LD 'X-RqUid=' LD:rquid ','"
| parse content, "LD 'X-Referer=' LD:referer ','"
| fieldsAdd service = splitString(referer, "-")[3]
| parse content, "LD '\"code\":\"' LD:error_code '\"'"
| parse content, "LD '\"system\":\"' LD:error_system '\"'"
| parse content, "LD '\"message\":\"' LD:error_message '\"'"
// body = from the first "{" after ::AUDIT::RESP:: up to ::HTTPCODE::
| parse content, "LD '::AUDIT::RESP::' LD:resp"
| fieldsAdd body_from = indexOf(resp, "{")
| fieldsAdd body = if(body_from >= 0, substring(resp, from: body_from), else: resp)
| fieldsAdd body = if(contains(body, "::HTTPCODE::"), substring(body, from: 0, to: lastIndexOf(body, "::HTTPCODE::")), else: body)
| fields timestamp, rquid, service, CH, code, error_system, error_message, body
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 200

14.title: LATENCIA ADAPTADOR (p95 ms)
14.query:
fetch logs
|filter dt.system.bucket =="logs_integracion"
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| parse aws.log_group, "'/aws/ecs/srv/' LD:cluster 'ws-'"
| filter in("*", $Cluster) or in(concat(cluster, "ws"), $Cluster)
| filter contains(content, "RSIN")
| parse content, "LD 'RSIN ' LD ':' LD ',3=' DOUBLE:ms_stratus"
| parse content, "LD 'RSIN ' LD ':' LD ', 1=' DOUBLE:ms_iseries"
| fieldsAdd adapter_ms = coalesce(ms_stratus, ms_iseries), adapter = replaceString(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/", "")
| filter isNotNull(adapter_ms)
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:channel_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd channel = coalesce(channel_a, channel_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ","))
| makeTimeseries p95_ms = percentile(adapter_ms, 95), by: { adapter }

18.title: % rechazo al canal (M)
18.query:
fetch logs
|filter dt.system.bucket =="logs_integracion"
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-mngr")
| parse aws.log_group, "'/aws/ecs/srv/' LD:cluster 'ws-'"
| filter in("*", $Cluster) or in(concat(cluster, "ws"), $Cluster)
| filter $Servicio == "*" or contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "<caracterAceptacion>") or contains(content, "<canal>")
| parse content, "LD '] [' LD:rquid '][INFO'"
| parse content, "LD '<Request>' LD '<canal>' LD:channel_req '</canal>'"
| parse content, "LD '<Response>' LD '<nombreOperacion>' LD:operation '</nombreOperacion>'"
| parse content, "LD '<caracterAceptacion>' LD:acceptance '</caracterAceptacion>'"
| parse content, "LD '<codMsgRespuesta>' LD:msg_code '</codMsgRespuesta>'"
| parse content, "LD '<msgRespuesta>' LD:msg '</msgRespuesta>'"
| summarize channel = takeAny(channel_req), operation = takeAny(operation), result = takeAny(acceptance),
    msg_code = takeAny(msg_code), msg = takeAny(msg), by: { rquid }
| filter isNotNull(result) and ($Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ",")))
| summarize value = round(100.0 * countIf(result == "M") / count(), decimals: 2)

21.title: RESUMEN ERRORES POR CANAL
21.query:
fetch logs
|filter dt.system.bucket =="logs_integracion"
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-mngr")
| parse aws.log_group, "'/aws/ecs/srv/' LD:cluster 'ws-'"
| filter in("*", $Cluster) or in(concat(cluster, "ws"), $Cluster)
| filter $Servicio == "*" or contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "[ERROR")
| parse content, "LD ' ERROR ' DATA:full_details"
| parse full_details, "'[' LD:uuid '][' LD:channel_raw ']' DATA:msg_raw"
| fieldsAdd channel = coalesce(channel_raw, "--"), message = coalesce(msg_raw, full_details)
| summarize total_errors = count(), by: { channel, message }
| sort total_errors desc
| limit 1000

22.query:

| filter contains(content, "BackendHttpAdapter") and contains(content, "RSOUT")
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:channel_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd channel = coalesce(channel_a, channel_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ","))
| parse content, "LD 'INFO  [' LD:trace '] [' LD:rquid '][' LD:req_channel '][' LD:service '][' LD:backend '][' LD:log_level '][' LD:tx_phase '][' LD:phase '][' DOUBLE:time_ms ' ' LD:unit ']'"
| summarize consumptions = count(), avg_ms = avg(time_ms), p95_ms = percentile(time_ms, 95), by: { req_channel, service }
| sort consumptions desc
| limit 1000

27.title: AUDITORIAS ADAPTADOR
